goal: Allow node operators to require encrypted v2 transport on clearnet connections
Prevents peer traffic and transaction relay from leaking to passive observers via v1 fallback
reviewability: Reviewable now, with no obstacles to reviewing the current implementation
agreement: Broad concept support for preventing plaintext traffic leaks to on-path observers (mzumsande, dergoegge)
Encouraged by high v2 network adoption and protection against packet inspection (sipa, ajtowns, laanwj)
Unaddressed objection: risks network partitions and misleads users on node obfuscation (1440000bytes)
Cold-start peer discovery concern on DNS seeds is tracked in an upstream PR (gmaxwell)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because node operators can enforce BIP324 encryption across clearnet connections
Protects peer traffic against passive snooping and prevents plaintext fallback on IPv4 and IPv6
